content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I need some assistance. When I press a push button (such as F1 or one externally connected to I1-I6), I want to measure the duration it remains pressed. Using this time, I need to perform some calculations and display the results on the [product_name] operator device. Could you advise how to achieve this? I tried using an off-delay but, after releasing the button, the timer resets. How can I retain the measured time for use in other calculations? Thank you in advance.
See: Activation time on the operator device display.
I think the attached program is straightforward. You can use B002 or B005 in your calculations.

Hello, Using the support you provided, I created a program—please check the attached project. In this setup, pressing F1 should increase B014's value from its previous state, while pressing F2 should decrease it. How can I implement this? Thanks for your assistance.

Hello, You need to store the last value and clear the input after the key is released. Please refer to the attachment for details. Best regards [user_name]. _________________________________________________ Useful resources: Collection of notes and circuits for programming with [product_name] Scaling signals using analog blocks Retrieving data from [product_name] Mathematical equations with [product_name]

Hello [user_name], Thank you for your assistance. Your solution is definitely helpful. I need one more modification. Is it possible to update the value immediately when the button is pressed, not after its release? The button action is dependent on the most recent value.

Hello, That's simple to set up: at the message box B004, change the displayed value from block B016 to block B014 and you'll meet the requirement you asked about. analysis.insight_summary: Participants explored methods for measuring how long a push button is held and ways to increment or decrement values based on button actions, with results shown on an operator device. Key focus areas included retaining and updating the time and count values for further calculations and ensuring immediate feedback when buttons are pressed. Several programming approaches and logic blocks were proposed, enabling a quick solution and improvement to the user experience.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants button press values to persist for further calculations, to be updated instantly when the button is pressed, and to be displayed without delay on the operator device. They prioritize intuitive programming and fast system responses for smooth user interaction.
